review.why: Tests local web apps with Playwright scripts, a server helper and a reconnaissance-then-action pattern in headless mode.
review.summary: Gives a decision tree for static versus dynamic apps, a helper that starts one or several dev servers around a script, and a pattern of waiting for network idle, inspecting the rendered page, picking selectors and then acting. Examples cover element discovery, static HTML and console logging. It tells the agent to run the helper with help first and treat it as a black box.
strengths: Decision tree for static pages versus running servers
Waits for network idle before inspecting dynamic pages
Helper manages backend and frontend servers together
cautions: Tells the agent not to read the helper's source first
